reason: The report concludes 'no effect' from a single specification whose null (b=0.106, SE 0.232, 95% CI about [-0.35, 0.56]) is at best 'no detectable effect'; it does not report any robustness checks. Adding buyer_rating_2023, a post-treatment variable measured in 2023, flips the estimate to -2.16 with p < 1e-20, and the report never addresses this sensitivity, though the null does hold across the pre-period-only specifications (b between 0.05 and 0.11, p > 0.6).
